campingAndFire.summary: No section-specific camping ban found, but the route lies in Vindelfjällen nature reserve and across sensitive Tärnasjön wetland/bird habitat. Use low-impact camping, avoid disturbance, and follow hut-host instructions near STF cabins.
camping: STF general tent/service policy applies at Tärnasjö and Syter. Using hut facilities while tenting requires a service fee; outdoor toilets are generally free. No official site-specific tent-place POI was found for either hut.
Field reports and route apps indicate camping is possible around Syter and along the section, but low lake/forest/wetland areas can be buggy and sensitive.
Do not invent or import standalone tent-site coordinates without a source-backed point.
fire: No live fire ban found for Sorsele or Storuman municipalities in the official fire-ban layer on 2026-04-30; this must be rechecked before import or user-facing currentness claims.
Reserve rules prohibit cutting/removing living or dead trees/shrubs. Prefer stove or established facilities and do not collect wood.
No official standalone fireplace/fire ring was found on this section; suppress fireplace POIs.

closureStatus.rationale: No official hiking closure, reroute or Tärnasjö-Syter bridge closure found on Länsstyrelsen/STF current sources as of 2026-04-30.
closureStatus.caveat: Absence of a closure notice does not guarantee summer hiking readiness or bridge condition, especially in shoulder season.

protectedAreaRules: Entire section is within Vindelfjällen nature reserve / Natura 2000.
Reserve rules prohibit disturbing wildlife, damaging vegetation/ground/stone and breaking/cutting/removing living or dead trees and shrubs.
Motor vehicles are restricted to designated snowmobile routes/permits; not a normal foot-hiking restriction.
Marsivagge has a 15 May-1 August entry ban, but no evidence was found that this exact Tärnasjö-Syter section enters that closed area.
wetlandBirdSensitivity: Tärnasjön is Ramsar site no. 29, 11,800 ha, and important for wetland birds.
No Tärnasjön-specific public entry ban was found in Länsstyrelsen Västerbotten's listed bird-protection areas. Model as sensitive wetland/bird area, not as closure.
Stay on marked trail, bridges and boardwalks; avoid unnecessary island/shore disturbance.
dogsAndReindeer: Naturvårdsverket: 1 March-20 August dogs must not run loose; in practice dogs usually need to be leashed.
Leash dogs near reindeer/grazing animals and where protected-area rules require it.
STF notes reindeer herding around Tärnasjö by Grans sameby; late April/May is sensitive calving/herding season.

fishingAndHunting: Fishing requires valid permits and special mountain-water rules.

Länsstyrelsen 2026 mountain-fishing publication lists a Tärnasjön special restriction: from Rasjejukke outlet to the snowmobile trail between Lenasuolo and mainland, fishing is prohibited until 1 July and from 31 August, except hand-gear fishing from lake ice.
Small-game hunting in Västerbotten mountain state land runs 25 August-15 March under permits; as of 2026-04-30 that season is not active.

conditionReports.summary: Reports shoreline walking, bathing spots/sandy beaches, island-connecting bridges and a tough final uphill after an otherwise easy stage. Mentions about 4 km from the lakes to Syter.
Calls the stage 14 km, 3-4 hours and easy, mostly flat except a short final climb. Highlights bridges island-to-island and Syter's scenic river setting.
Route app lists about 14.5 km and moderate difficulty. Recent entries include July 2025 good conditions/fine views/few people; August 2024 flags bugs and mud.

conditionReports.reportDate: published about August/September 2025; field date late summer 2025 inferred
conditionReports.summary: From STF Tärnasjö south: easy-going, boardwalks with dragonflies, eastern lake shore, then five bridges to the west side before continuing toward Syter/Syterskal. Useful recent evidence for boardwalks, wildlife and no water/crossing issue reported.

conditionReports.reportDate: published 2025-07-21; field date around 2025-07-03 for Serve-Syter/Tärnasjö-Syter day
conditionReports.summary: Notes the swing footbridge network at southern Tärnasjön, strong wind at Syter, kind wardens, no shop at Syter and a leftover-food/gear shelf. Adjacent Syter-Hemavan still had snow fields on 2025-07-04, relevant for early-season context.

conditionReports.reportDate: field date 31 Aug; year not visible
conditionReports.summary: Combined Serve-Syter day; trail was extremely slippery in rain, stony/rooty but otherwise easy, not very hilly until the last 5 km uphill. After Tärnasjö it follows the lake and small islands before the climb.

Reports Tärnasjö-Syter as a very pleasant 14 km stage. Large bridges near the end, with the last bridge swaying uncomfortably in gale-strength wind. Camped outside Syterstugan; frost/ice in tent by next morning.

Winter field evidence: lunch at Tärnasjö, continued to Syter, which is beautifully placed at the treeline beside the stream. Adjacent Syter-Viterskalet had hard wind, wet snow/rain and difficult ski glide.
Reverse-direction route-app listing, 14.97 km / 96 m gain; notes rainy conditions and refers to the seven bridges. Useful mainly for bridge-count confirmation and subjective scenery contrast.

conditionReports.reportDate: Tärnasjö highlight dates 2020-05-18 and 2023-07-27; Syter highlight 2023-02-23
conditionReports.summary: Tärnasjö entries praise sauna by the water and camping availability. Syter highlight confirms hut/camping availability and Syter's role as base for Norra Sytertoppen.

Says boat service over Tärnasjö has been discontinued since 2017, so walkers use the bridges. General southern-section warnings include mosquitoes in low lake/wetland terrain, unreliable mobile signal and usual stream-water caution.

lanes.summary: Confirmed identity/order, official names and aliases, distances/times, route description, endpoint coordinates, Tärnasjö/Syter official hut facilities, bridge/connectors and protected/admin context.

Confirmed Naturkartan site 14045, direction reversal, endpoint gaps, OSM/Waymarked relation 18709394 and wrong-line risks. Coordinator independently verified Naturvårdsverket AC2 WKT/open-data as the preferred primary candidate.

Collected Tärnasjö carry-forward cluster, seven selected bridge POIs, bridge-cluster toilets/shelter/life ring, Syter hut/help-phone/toilet/wood cluster and suppressions for Syter shop/sauna/fireplace/tap/viewpoint/off-route objects.

Confirmed no direct ground access at either endpoint; documented Syter side-access chains via Norra Fjällnäs, Solberg/Fjällgården, Umasjö and Hemavan, plus helicopter access as separate non-ground metadata.
Synthesized field evidence for boardwalks/wetlands/mud, bridge-count language, water, camping, insects, Syter wind/exposure, snow/shoulder-season context and Syter no-shop field note.

Found no official section closure; documented Vindelfjällen rules, Tärnasjön Ramsar/wetland sensitivity, dog/reindeer rules, fire/weather checks, hut seasons, fishing restrictions and current winter/snowmobile notices.
